subject: Privileged manager reassignment: interim coverage and review coordination
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privileged manager reassignment: interim coverage and review coordination

Team —

Quick note to start a discreet thread: Diego Fernandez is requesting an eight-week medical leave starting Aug 2. We need an interim manager for his Platform team, and I want to make sure we coordinate this with Diego's upcoming performance calibration (cycle closes Aug 10) and the compensation review queue.

Attached are Diego's latest summary and a draft interim coverage plan for your review:
- diego_perf_Q2.pdf (PDF, ~120KB)
- interim_coverage_plan.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

Primary asks:
- Can we confirm one interim lead by next Tue (Jul 26)?
- If promotion or reassignments are on the table for any directs, lets surface them before the review lock.
- Ben: can you confirm headcount/comp windows and whether any approvals are required from Finance?

This is a sensitive item (personnel + health). Please keep distribution tight. I will handle the HR paperwork and will loop in Legal only if we need contract exceptions.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: diego_perf_Q2.pdf]
[attachment: interim_coverage_plan.xlsx]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privileged manager reassignment: interim coverage and review coordination

Laura —

Thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. A couple quick points/questions: 

1) For interim coverage, I think Priya Natarajan could be a strong fit on the people side; she's already shadowing Diego on the reliability front. She is currently IC; we'd need a temporary manager title + a carve-out for CRM quota reassignment.

2) About the performance window: the direct reports with open calibrations are Marta Alvarez and Karthik Iyer. If we move them between managers before Aug 10, that could affect their calibration notes. I suggest we freeze any manager change that affects calibration until you confirm the plan in writing.

3) On comp: we'll likely need a fast-track approval if we change comp bands for anyone. Ben, can you confirm the approval latency (2–3 days / 1 week)?

I agree on keeping this tight. For now I approve moving forward with the interim plan, provided HR confirms the freeze approach for calibration.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Laura / Rachel —

I reviewed the coverage plan. Quick summary:
- Headcount: we have a temporary pool and can cover a title change for up to 12 weeks without new reqs.
- Comp approvals: any permanent comp band changes require Manager + Director + Finance sign-off. For temporary interim titles with no comp change, we do not need Finance sign-off.

Given that, I'm comfortable approving a temporary manager title for Priya as long as compensation remains unchanged. If we intend to promote anyone (permanent band change) we need to get Finance looped and allow 5–7 business days for approvals.

I signed the internal transfer form and uploaded it here: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/Envelope/abc123
(transfer-form-signed.pdf attached for your records).

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
